descripcion_geo: Small Aramaic kingdom northeast of Lake Galilee, on the Golan Plateau. Ally and then enemy of David.
importancia_estrategica: Territory that David could not conquer; Their king Talmai was Absalom's grandfather.

historias.titulo: David marries the princess of Gesur
historias.descripcion: David took as his wife Maacah, daughter of King Talmai of Geshur; Absalom was born to her.

historias.titulo: Absalom flees to Geshur after killing Amnon
historias.descripcion: After killing his half-brother Amnon to avenge Tamar's rape, Absalom flees to his grandfather Talmai's court in Geshur.

historias.titulo: Joab negotiates the return of Absalom from Geshur
historias.descripcion: Joab convence a David de permitir que Absalón regrese de Gesur; David accepts it but it will take two years to see it.

personajes.descripcion: Son of the princess of Gesur; It was refuge and exile for his mother; led the largest rebellion against David.
Absalom's maternal grandfather; He gave shelter to his grandson after the murder of Amnon.

personajes.rol: Princess of Gesur, wife of David
personajes.descripcion: Daughter of the king of Geshur; mother of Absalom and Tamar.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Gesur: relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: Geshur was Absalom's refuge after his crime; The exile of a prince in a foreign land is a recurring motif in the biblical narrative.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Geshur was Absalom's refuge after his crime; The exile of a prince in a foreign land is a recurring motif in the biblical narrative.
